body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> Solar Park(www.solarpark.co.kr) has presented its new solar-powered lamp. The photofile on the surface absorbs sunlight in the daytime, which is converted into electric power and stored in internal battery. When the sensor perceives sunset, it is automatically turned off. Since you don’t need to use cable, it is easy to install also durable. It seems convenient while climbing mountain or countryside where electric power is not available. If you need more information, visit the website or contact 82-2-541-8840 <AVING Special Report Team for ‘KES2005’ : Editor&Publisher, Jason Lee, Joshua Shim, Nikki Whang, Sheri Choi, Sophia Kwag, Annie Park, Caleb Ma, edited by Daniel Sirh>
